primer: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS business rating and PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. Its VelociSuite engine delivers 82.7% gross margins, $16.2B in net cash, and 36% YoY Q3 2026 sales growth to $5.12B. At $937.15 (13.20x forward P/E), shares trade well below our $1,225.00 3-year (FY2029E) base target. Because REGN sits 10.01% above its 10-week EMA ($851.85) in a Downtrend, our verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT ($849.43–$922.44 buy zone; $734.09 stop; 1.61:1–2.23:1 R:R).
